errors.error_description: Introduced multiple active drivers by assigning to status_bus as a whole and then separately driving status_bus[0], causing bus contention on that bit.
Created an excessively deep nested if-else chain in the next-state logic, producing long combinational paths and poor synthesis quality.
Declared an identifier using an escaped SystemVerilog keyword (\always) as a signal name, which misuses a reserved word as an identifier.
